dyadic_potential.scope: Auxiliary cutoff arithmetic only; no Collatz orbit census at these large dyadic cutoffs.

closed_collatz_witness.scope: The supplied finite paths are also checked in Lean; persistence and signed cancellation for all later clocks are generic kernel consequences.

boundary_profile_and_finite_parity.scope: Exact finite checks of the written uniform boundary profile and elementary finite-parity mean bound; their all-scale and limiting assembly is not newly kernel formalized.

actual_prefix_census.scope: Direct ordinary Collatz prefixes for every source, independent of the cutoff recurrence.

rounded_cutoff_trees.longer_tree_scope: Cutoff averaging and proved clock-zero/one arithmetic only; no census of long Collatz trajectories at the largest leaf cutoffs.

ideal_size_tilt.scope: Ideal unrounded real cutoff chain, not actual Collatz or the rounded integer chain; exact rational change-of-measure checks.
